thread:
Michelle: Quick sync — are we green to cut the console observability changes for next sprint? Need tracing hook PRs merged, retention policy doc finalized, and error-analysis UIs ready. Any blockers?

Raj: On tracing hooks — PR #452 is open, awaiting review. I need one more +1 from Lena. Tests are flaky on long-tail traces.

Lena: I'm on it, will prioritize review today. Flaky failing case is in span-serializer; I pushed a fix to branch `trace/fix-serializer` and kicked CI.

Ethan: Retention policy doc — I left comments on section about cold storage TTLs. Also we need infra tickets to move some indices to low-cost nodes. Not blocked, but ETA is EOW.

Michelle: Thanks. Can we get a quick decision on retention_days? Product suggests 90, security wants 365. We proposed tiered retention in doc.

Lena: For console observability I'd prefer: errors & traces = 90, perf aggregations = 365, raw logs = 30. I'll put that in the doc and tag security.

Raj: Re: flaky tests — simple repro:

```
pytest tests/instrumentation/test_span.py::test_serialize_long_stack
# fails on py3.11 in CI
```

I can add a skip if not reproducible locally, but prefer to fix. ETA for fix: today.

Ara-Bot: @channel CI: `trace-fix-serializer` build #789 succeeded. All checks passed :white_check_mark: 

Michelle: Great. Error analysis UI — Lena, can you confirm all the new views have correct query params? (per-route lens, sparkline heatmap, regression filter)

Ethan: I validated per-route lens queries against prod schema — one alias mismatch in `route_name` which I fixed in the migration. Will push patch in infra PR.

Lena: UI code ready, but the regression filter depends on the retention policy merging. If retention stays long we can show longer baselines.

Michelle: Ok next steps: Raj finish serializer fix + merge PR; Lena update retention doc and tag security; Ethan land infra node migration PR; I'll open a rollout plan and canary checklist. Small follow-ups in this thread if anything changes.

DeployBot: Canary plan draft posted: https://redwood.internal/canaries/console-obsv-canary — pinging staging owners.

Raj: Merged PR, rolling to staging now. pinging @Lena for post-deploy smokecheck.

Lena: Smokecheck passed locally, will validate staging in 30m.
